caption: Test cases written in Gherkin
text: Here are the test cases, written in plain Gherkin. The tester picks which ones to run.

caption: Step 1: open the web console
text: First, it opens the web console on the desktop.

caption: Step 2: phone on the Home screen
text: Then the phone goes to its Home screen, and old notifications are cleared.

caption: Step 3: open the app
text: Next it opens the app on the phone and loads the receiver page.

caption: Wait for a condition, no sleeps
text: There are no fixed sleeps. It waits until the page is really shown.

caption: AI taps Subscribe
text: The AI taps Subscribe, then waits for the pairing code to appear.

caption: Web sends the notification
text: Back on the web, it enters the pairing code, the title and the message, and clicks Send.

caption: Check the Android shade
text: Finally, it opens the notification shade on Android and confirms the message arrived.

caption: Test case passed
text: The test case turns green. One Gherkin file, from the web to a native app.
